public_body: Chatham Affordable Housing Trust Board Of Trustees
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the chair could not reasonably anticipate a member's remarks on a letter published the same afternoon, so the topic did not need to be on the notice.

allegations.summary: Alleged the June 26 meeting notice was too vague because it did not list a board member's planned remarks responding to a newspaper letter to the editor.
allegations.key_passage: Although best practice might have warranted deferring the discussion to a later meeting, the Chair was not required to do so, and we find no violation of the Open Meeting Law.
